content.title: Sofi Stock Rises. What Trump’s Changes to Student Loans Could Mean for the Fintech.
content.summary: Shares of  SoFi Technologies  gained Tuesday following a report that said the Trump administration would consider selling parts of the federal government’s roughly $1.6 trillion student loan portfolio to the private market.  Senior officials at the Treasury and Department of Education have discussed selling high-performing portions of the portfolio, Politico reported, citing people familiar with the matter.  The news appeared to be giving SoFi stock a boost.
